scenes.summary: Mira wins the fox lantern at a festival stall; Kenji tugs free of her hand and disappears into the crowd.
scenes.action: Lantern stall glows. Mira receives the fox-faced lantern, smiling. Kenji's hand slips from hers; he darts between yukata-clad festival-goers and is gone.

dialogue.line: Look, the drums! I want to see!

scenes.continuity_notes: Mira holds the fox lantern in her LEFT hand from here on. Festival crowd background, red-gold light.
scenes.transition_out_hint: quick cut on Mira's alarmed face

scenes.summary: Alone in a quiet lane, the lantern unfolds into Hoshi the fox spirit.
scenes.action: Mira stands in an empty lantern-lit lane. Her paper lantern trembles, unfolds mid-air into a small glowing fox. It bows.

dialogue.line: You kept my flame lit. So I will light your way.

scenes.continuity_notes: Same left-hand lantern until it transforms; after this scene Mira carries no lantern.
scenes.transition_out_hint: match cut from Hoshi's glow to ember-lights

recheck.dedupe_report: No duplicates in the 2-scene fixture; durations rebalanced 15->14s on S01.
fixed_issues: S01 duration trimmed to keep the alarmed-face beat inside the clip
